item.title: Penn State’s Tessa Janecke, Team USA to Compete in Olympic Gold Medal Game
item.description: Penn State star Tessa Janecke is looking to add some hardware to her collection. Arguably the most accomplished player in Nittany Lion women’s hockey history, Janecke will compete for an Olympic gold medal with Team USA on Thursday at 1:10 p.m. The red, white and blue will face off against the winner of the other semifinal between Canada and Switzerland, set to take place at 3:10 p.m. on Monday, available on Peacock or NBCOlympics.com. item.title: Penn State Releases Date for Blue-White Weekend
item.description: Time to mark the calendars. After much anticipation, Penn State announced its annual Blue-White Weekend will take place on April 25, though no further information was provided. A social media post from the football program state more details will follow. Head coach Matt Campbell confirmed earlier this month the team would "certainly do something" this spring, though he declined to share any more details. item.title: Penn State Expected to Hire Kashif Moore as Wide Receivers Coach
item.description: Penn State's 2026 coaching staff appears to be finalized — again. The Nittany Lions are expected to hire Colorado State's Kashif Moore as their next wide receivers coach according to multiple reports, including from CBS Sports' Matt Zenitz. Moore had just been hired by the Rams in December as the wide receivers coach and passing game coordinator. item.title: Nittany Valley Symphony to Perform Free Family Concert
item.description: Nittany Valley Symphony will offer a fun, indoor event for families with an upcoming concert featuring a musical program suited for young audiences. The concert, "Carnival of the Animals," will take place at 3 p.m. Sunday, Feb. 22, at the State College Area High School Performing Arts Center. Tickets are free to the public thanks to support from The Happy Valley Adventure Bureau and Centre Foundation, and can be reserved online at nvs.org/upcoming-events/carnivaloftheanimals. item.title: ‘A Taste of the Town’ Dinner to Benefit Osaze’s Heart Scholarship
item.description: An upcoming fundraiser dinner featuring international flavors from local caterers, entertainment and a silent auction will support the 2026 Osaze’s Heart Community Service Scholarship. Organized by the Osaze’s Heart Scholarship Committee, "A Taste of the Town" will be held from 5 to 7 p.m. on March 18 at the State College Municipal Building. item.title: Subu Vedam Denied Release on Bond From ICE Custody
item.description: A State College man who spent more than 40 years in prison before his murder conviction was overturned will remain in federal custody as his immigration case proceeds following a judge's ruling on Tuesday morning. item.title: Hoppy Valley Brewers Fest Returns for 3rd Year in New Location
item.description: A craft beverage festival is returning to the State College area for its third year with a new location and an expanded variety of offerings.
